summary: GDEV Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, providing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held August 28, 2026. The filing includes the AGM notice, proxy notice, proxy card, and a proposed amended and restated memorandum and articles. Agenda items are the re-election of directors and approval of the amended governing documents. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves the equivalent of a U.S. proxy statement. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic event are present.
